summary.text: Tim Wesco is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 21, has served since 2010, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. His professional background includes work as a firefighter and a real estate business owner.

paragraphs.text: Timothy Wesco earned an associate's degree from the Midwest School of Theology.

His professional experience includes working as a firefighter in the Penn Township Fire Department, as owner and operator of Providence Real Estate, and as a technician with Wesco Piano Tuning and Service.
Wesco has served in the Indiana House since 2010 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Democrat Charles Burkley.
